sources.case_colours_hand: Hand whose ZTCF/ZVCF/total colours (src/config/ztcf_zvcf_hand_colours.json) the ground arrow wears, so a case reads in one colour on hands and feet; lead is the Okabe-Ito tip-to-tail default.
sources.min_vertical_n: Net vertical load (N) at or below which the centre of pressure is undefined (moment over a vanishing force): no ground arrow is drawn rather than a point at infinity or NaN.
sources.key_ground: Colour-key row of the case's ground arrow; arrow_label prefixes its glyph label.
